name: Hannibal
description: Both a gift and a curse, Graham has the extraordinary ability to think like his prey—he sees what they see, feels what they feel. But while Graham is pursuing an especially troubling, cannibalistic murderer, Special Agent Jack Crawford teams him with a highly respected psychiatrist – a man with a taste for the criminal minded – Dr. Hannibal Lecter.

videos.title: Œuf (NBC Web Version)
videos.overview:
Two families are found murdered, with both mothers killed last. The only link between the families is that they both have sons who have been on the missing persons list for approximately a year. 

NBC decided not to air the full episode and instead offered this web only version that was approximately 20 minutes long.

videos.title: Apéritif
videos.overview: When the FBI takes on a case of disappearing college girls, Jack Crawford recruits Will Graham, a gifted criminal profiler with a unique view into the psyche of serial killers, to consult. Jack also seeks the help of Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist. After a copycat strikes, Will and Hannibal join forces to track down the culprit.

videos.title: Amuse-Bouche
videos.overview: Will and Jack race to apprehend a serial killer using humans as fertilizer.

videos.title: Potage
videos.overview: Abigail Hobbs comes out of her coma with new information about her father.

videos.title: Œuf
videos.overview: A series of family murders takes place.

videos.title: Coquilles
videos.overview: Jack and Will search for a killer who turns his victims into angels.

videos.title: Entrée
videos.overview: The Chesapeake Ripper taunts Jack Crawford with guilt from the past.

videos.title: Sorbet
videos.overview: Will races to stop a rogue surgeon extracting organs from his victims.

videos.title: Fromage
videos.overview: A deadly symphony hall killing forces Will to hunt a defiant killer.

videos.title: Trou Normand
videos.overview: Will, Jack and the BAU team hunt for a serial killer who creates a totem pole out of his victims' bodies.

videos.title: Buffet Froid
videos.overview: Will tracks a killer with mental instability similar to his own.

videos.title: Rôti
videos.overview: When Dr. Gideon escapes to terrorize Alana and Dr. Chilton, Hannibal and Will go on the hunt. Eddie Izzard guest stars.

videos.title: Relevés
videos.overview: Hannibal convinces Jack and Alana that Will could be the copycat killer.

videos.title: Savoureux
videos.overview: Hannibal frames Will, convincing Jack and Alana that Will's the copycat killer.

videos.title: Kaiseki
videos.overview: With Will Graham in prison, the FBI investigates his claims against Hannibal. A new serial killer emerges.

videos.title: Sakizuke
videos.overview: As the FBI seeks Will's help in tracking a killer who turns his victims' bodies into art, Will plots to reveal the truth about Hannibal.

videos.title: Hassun
videos.overview: As Will's murder trial begins, a copycat killer sends a gruesome message. Jack is under pressure to wrap up Will's case while Hannibal hopes for his friend's exoneration.

videos.title: Takiawase
videos.overview: Emboldened after drug therapy from Dr. Chilton, Will sets a deadly plan in place to expose Hannibal. A new killer is turning victims into beehives.

videos.title: Mukōzuke
videos.overview: The BSU investigates Beverly's death after her body is found displayed in a gruesome tableau. Abel Gideon returns to the Baltimore Hospital for the Criminally Insane. Will seeks a horrific revenge for Beverly's death.

videos.title: Futamono
videos.overview: Jack suspects Hannibal might be the Chesapeake Ripper as two more victims turn up. Hannibal and Alana distance themselves from Will.

videos.title: Yakimono
videos.overview: As Miriam Lass begins her recovery, Will is released from prison and resumes his pursuit of Hannibal.

videos.title: Su-zakana
videos.overview: Will resumes his therapy with Dr. Lecter. The FBI investigates the murder of a woman whose body was found sewn inside a dead horse.

videos.title: Shiizakana
videos.overview: Margot Verger seeks out Will as she tries to understand Hannibal. The FBI searches for an animalistic killer who tears his victims' bodies apart.

videos.title: Naka-Choko
videos.overview: Will's readiness to go to dark places strengthens his bond with Hannibal.

videos.title: Kō No Mono
videos.overview: Will and Margot hide her pregnancy from Mason. After Freddie's gruesome murder, Alana's doubts about Will and Hannibal grow stronger.

videos.title: Tome-wan
videos.overview: Bedelia returns and accepts immunity to testify against Hannibal. Mason Verger plots revenge after learning of Hannibal's manipulations.

videos.title: Mizumono
videos.overview: Springing their trap, Jack, Will and Alana face off with Hannibal in a bloody final showdown, but the doctor has a few surprises of his own.

videos.title: Antipasto
videos.overview: After the devastating bloodbath at the Lecter home, Hannibal establishes a new life for himself in Italy along with the company of his own psychiatrist, Bedelia.

videos.title: Primavera
videos.overview: With his wounds now healed, Will Graham heads to Europe eight months after the horrific event that almost took his life, in search of closure with Hannibal Lecter. Meanwhile, an Italian inspector suspects that Lecter and a killer he pursued 20 years earlier are the same person.

videos.title: Secondo
videos.overview: Will continues his search, making his way to Hannibal's childhood home in Lithuania. Meanwhile, Jack Crawford arrives in Italy, hoping to find Will and intervene before tragedy strikes again, and Bedelia warns Hannibal against unraveling his new life.

videos.title: Aperitivo
videos.overview: After surviving a disfiguring gunshot, Dr. Fredrick Chilton rallies support to capture Hannibal using Will as bait. Jack is distracted by Bella's failing health, but implores Will to abandon the risky idea of finding Hannibal. Meanwhile, Alana Bloom entertains a different approach, partnering with Mason Verger to utilize his vast resources.

videos.title: Contorno
videos.overview: Will travels via train with Chiyoh to Florence, as Alana and Mason use Hannibal's fine tastes to track his whereabouts. Pazzi tries to get in close to find out if Hannibal is the man he's looking for, but his greed may get the better of him.

videos.title: Dolce
videos.overview: With Bedelia securing her alibi, Hannibal prepares to leave Florence just as Jack and Will begin to track him down. However, Chiyoh has arrived in Florence with her own agenda.

videos.title: Digestivo
videos.overview: Captured in Italy by police on Mason Verger's payroll, Will Graham and Hannibal Lecter are delivered to Muskrat Farm to await Mason's revenge.

videos.title: The Great Red Dragon
videos.overview: Hannibal has been under lock and key for three years at the Baltimore State Hospital for the Criminally Insane when a new villain arises - Francis Dolarhyde, also known as "The Tooth Fairy." Crawford approaches Will to help catch the vicious serial killer targeting families.

videos.title: And the Woman Clothed with the Sun…
videos.overview: Wading deeper into dangerous territory, Will enlists the help of Hannibal Lecter to assist with the search for an elusive serial killer. Elsewhere, a new woman comes into Dolarhyde's life.

videos.title: And the Woman Clothed in Sun
videos.overview: Carvings symbolizing the Great Red Dragon shed light on Francis Dolarhyde's disturbing psychology. Will feels his bond with Hannibal growing uncomfortably stronger, and seeks out Bedelia Du Maurier, the only other person who fully understands the complexities of such a relationship.

videos.title: And the Beast from the Sea
videos.overview: Convinced that the Red Dragon will strike at the next full moon, Jack and Will grow desperate, and Alana turns to Hannibal for help.

videos.title: The Number of the Beast is 666…
videos.overview: Will enlists Dr. Frederick Chilton to lure Francis Dolarhyde into an ambush, using Freddie Lounds as their mouthpiece. Meanwhile, Dolarhyde senses that the FBI is closing in and launches a horrifying endgame.

videos.title: The Wrath of the Lamb
videos.overview: In a desperate bid to slay Francis Dolarhyde, Will engineers a cunning ploy involving Hannibal.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 27 wins & 59 nominations total
